heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro — advanced foundation models for professional visual content creation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a full-bleed dark hero with layered dashboard-style panels floating over a warm bronze mesh gradient. Place the headline in a compact stacked block on the left-center and let the media dominate the right and lower plane through overlapping product shells: a prompt-to-image output strip, a video preview card with audio waveform, and a small control-panel UI. Keep the composition asymmetrical and operational rather than cinematic. Use bronze CTA buttons only, with trust chips directly beneath the subheadline and subtle grid lines, noise texture, and soft spotlight orbs to create premium depth. Autoplay is not recommended; use a looping preview card or still-frame gallery treatment for the video asset to preserve performance and trust.

repetitionBreakers: Use a full-bleed hero with overlay, then switch to a compact static logo proof band to break the opening rhythm.
Make the products section alternating and visual-first, not a repeat of the hero layout.
Use a spotlight-plus-grid pattern for Seedream, then switch to a split-panel list for Seedance to avoid feature-block repetition.
Keep testimonials as a tighter 3-card grid so it feels different from the proof and product sections.
End with a centered conversion strip instead of another wide media panel.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Image & Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Explore ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for premium AI image and video generation. Create high-resolution visuals, synchronized audio-video content, and production-ready creative outputs.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark full-bleed canvas with subtle overlay, floating proof chips, and a compact product shell preview
sections.designNote: PrimaryGoal: immediately explain that this is ByteDance’s premium AI image and video generation suite for creative professionals. NarrativeMode: ad-continuity first, then technical authority. TrustStrategy: light trust badges embedded in the hero, but real proof comes next. VisualDominance: hero-product, with a strong background visual shell and compact text stack. CTAAggression: single high-visibility 'Get started' button only, full-width on mobile, accent fill at 100% opacity. SectionDensity: medium-high, with concise bullets under the headline. RecommendedHeroStyle: full-bleed-with-overlay, content-first but visually anchored. Headline must answer what it is; subheadline must answer who it is for; CTA must answer what to do next.

Logos-first trust treatment using a clean static flex-wrap band of 3-6 recognisable logos; if logo assets are unavailable, convert to a compact metric strip. Keep it immediately after the hero to satisfy warm-traffic continuity and establish premium legitimacy without a marquee effect.

Three-step process in under 60 seconds: 1) describe your visual, 2) choose image or video generation, 3) export production-ready creative. Use a highly scannable numbered layout with one illustrated step panel and two compact text steps. This section should feel operational and fast, not explanatory or salesy.

Use alternating product blocks instead of a generic SaaS grid. Start with Seedream 4.5 in a spotlight-plus-grid format because it has 5+ features and needs a preview panel: prioritize advanced text-image alignment, high-resolution output, typographic rendering, multi-image composition, and structural fidelity. Then switch to Seedance 1.5 Pro in a split-panel list with a strong preview area and concise capability bullets, emphasizing synchronized audio-video generation, text-to-video, multilingual lip-sync, cinematic camera control, and faster inference. Keep the first block visually richer than the second to create rhythm and avoid adjacent repetition.

Industry-specific proof framed as recognizable expert testimonials, because logos are the primary trust layer but user-provided endorsements reinforce confidence. Use a 3-card grid with Creative Director, Video Producer, and Art Director quotes. Keep the visual system dense but calm, with subtle borders and no large media treatment.

Feature emphasis should narrow to the two click-driving capabilities: high-quality AI image generation and synchronized AI video generation. Present as one visual spotlight panel with a compact comparison row beneath it. This is not a full feature dump; it is a persuasion pivot that translates product depth into a creator outcome.

Use a highlighted card-centered pricing/cart block, but keep it lightweight and product-led. Present Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro as selectable quote/demo paths rather than a traditional pricing matrix. Maintain the single CTA rule by using only 'Get started' as the button label, even inside product cards.

Final conversion section should be a centered card with one clear next step and minimal fields. Keep the copy focused on seeing the models in action, not on signing up. Mobile CTA must be full-width and accent-filled. This closing section should feel like the most direct action moment on the page.
Minimal endcap only. Keep it utilitarian and quiet so the page ends on the CTA rather than adding extra narrative weight.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with strong headline, short supporting copy, benefit bullets, and a single prominent primary CTA; brand/logo anchor placed above content; no visible secondary CTA.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top-heavy landing page with a hero band followed by a conversion form block; content is structured in stacked sections with clear separation and minimal lateral complexity.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-first cards with simple borders/shadows, compact headings, and dense descriptive text; no glassmorphism, no decorative card overlays, and no hover-driven storytelling implied.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is singular and action-oriented; repeated CTA appears inside feature/product sections as a demo/request-style action; no sticky CTA bar detected.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not visible in the reference markup; treat as omitted or minimal-endcap.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-led hero with no prominent hero illustration in the provided markup; content relies on text hierarchy and icon bullets rather than media panels.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Feature sections are presented as stacked product blocks with a label, headline, descriptive paragraph, and a list of capabilities; supports progressive disclosure through section-by-section storytelling rather than tabs or accordions.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead-capture form block immediately after hero; form is enclosed in a bordered card with a headline and multiple hidden fields for tracking/qualification; conversion intent is explicit and high-friction aware.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation; any motion would be limited to standard page utilities rather than narrative animation.
componentPatterns: Benefit bullet list with icon markers
designNotes: Use a direct B2B lead-gen layout with a single dominant CTA.
Keep the hero concise and benefit-led, with bullets for scannability.
Prefer stacked, linear storytelling over interactive navigation patterns.
Use a plain form card immediately after the hero to capture intent early.
Maintain generous whitespace and clear section separation for enterprise credibility.
Avoid ornamental effects; rely on hierarchy, spacing, and typographic contrast.

mustHaveMoments: Dark-theme hero with strong headline, concise supporting copy, and one dominant primary CTA

avoidPatterns: No hidden or hero-only page behavior
No missing form if the page requires lead capture; if form is not part of the content map, do not invent one
No sticky top strip that blocks the page or interrupts scrolling
No mismatched content beyond the provided Seedream and Seedance scope

designStrategy.reasoning: This page should behave like a high-intent product landing page for creative professionals who already understand AI generation but need confidence in quality, capability, and vendor legitimacy. Because the trust instruction says logos are the dominant signal, the structure should lead with brand credibility and enterprise readiness rather than emotional storytelling. A split hero is the best fit: message on one side, product/value reinforcement on the other, with a single strong CTA. Since the content is medium-volume and the reference pattern favors stacked storytelling, the page should stay readable with clear vertical separation, not dense multi-column complexity. The dark theme supports a premium, modern AI positioning, and a video gallery is essential to make Seedance feel tangible. The overall direction should maximize demo/quote conversion while keeping the page clean, credible, and product-led.
